description: OpenAgents on your phone: chat with OpenAgents, a Bitcoin wallet, and the computers you connect, where Coder, our coding agent, does the work. No sign-in is needed.
whatToTest:
Welcome to the OpenAgents beta. No sign-in is needed.

1. The menu button at the top left opens Coder, Computers, Wallet, Verse, Settings, and your recent chats.
2. Coder: on a new chat the cards move on by themselves; tap Try it, or ask anything in Ask OpenAgents. The answer streams in, and a reply that names web pages shows a card for each.
3. Verse: tap Verse at the top (or Try it on Explore the Verse) and walk around the Grid with your avatar; tap Coder to come back.
4. Wallet: your balance, Receive, and Send. It is a real Bitcoin wallet, so keep only small amounts in it during the beta.
5. Settings: open each row. To reach your own computer, open Computers > Connect a computer and follow the steps there.

Something wrong? Settings > Report a problem, or take a screenshot and send it as TestFlight feedback.

review.notes:
No sign-in, account, or demo login is needed: the app has no login. On first launch it makes its own device key.

1. Coder (opens first): type a question such as "What is OpenAgents?" or tap Try it on a card. The answer comes from our hosted assistant and streams in.
2. Verse: the switch at the top opens the Grid, a shared 3D world where you walk around as an avatar with the on-screen sticks; Coder comes back.
3. The menu button at the top left opens Computers, Wallet, Settings, and recent chats. Wallet is a self-custody Bitcoin wallet created on the device; reviewing it needs no funds, and Receive shows a request to be paid. Settings has Report a problem, Computers, Appearance, Your keys, Identity keys, About this device, Changelog, Source code, and Follow us on X.

Computers is optional: it pairs the phone with a computer running our command-line app (install: curl -fsSL https://openagents.com/cli/install.sh | bash; then openagents connect invite shows a code to scan). Nothing else in the app needs a computer.

Contact: chris@openagents.com
